about.metaDescription: J. S. One Sdn Bhd (200601030140/749898-T) - OpenText ECM Suite specialists for SAP Solutions, AMS, and system development since October 2006.
about.heroSubtitle: We care for your content growth of tomorrow.
about.overviewBody1: JSONE was set up in October 2006. We specialize in the OpenText Enterprise Content Management (ECM) Suite - especially ECM Suite for SAP Solutions such as Data Archiving, Archiving, Document Access, and Vendor Invoice Management for SAP Solutions.
about.overviewBody2: Committed to delivering value, we work with customers to support and manage critical business drivers through effective IT systems and business processes. We design and implement solutions to complex business problems by building composite applications that combine functions and processes from multiple systems.
about.missionBody: We believe that we are on the face of the earth to make great solutions. We constantly focus on innovating, prefer the simple over the complex, own and control the primary technologies behind the solutions we make, and participate only in markets where we can make a significant contribution.
about.visionBody: Our vision is to be Asia’s most customer centric company; to build a solution where customer value and embrace.
about.valueBody: Acknowledgement and appreciation of each customer’s individual uniqueness needs and culture.
about.whyProcessBody: Our consultants are experienced SAP technical and business consultants. We help clients implement complete archiving and ECM strategies - from database analysis and workshops to retrieval methods via SAP Document Access by OpenText.
about.whyDevBody: We provide web and mobile application development so customers can extend enterprise processes with applications that fit how people work.
about.whyDataBody: Beyond core OpenText shared services - including accounts payable automation, case management, employee file management, and eSign - we also support security and surveillance (C4ISR) and big-data analysis initiatives.
about.whyManagedBody: Application Management Services based in Malaysia provide operational support to clients, with comprehensive post go-live coverage for OpenText and SAP landscapes.
about.timeline2006SetupBody: JSONE was set up in October 2006
about.timeline2006ProjectBody: First project completion outside of Malaysia
about.timeline2006SapAwardBody: Best SAP Technology Platform Project (Commercial Sector Category)
about.timeline2006SapCertBody: SAP granted the status of OpenText SAP Competence Partner to JS One
about.timeline2017BigDataBody: Completed Big Data Project for government agency 25TB from 36 different locations
about.timeline2018MscBody: Moved to Bangsar South Vertical Office
about.timeline2018RegionalBody: Regional expansion with offices in Singapore
about.timeline2019BwBody: First major migration and upgrade for a major O&G customer

legal.privacyMeta: How J. S. One Sdn Bhd collects, uses, and protects personal information.
legal.privacyIntro: J. S. One Sdn Bhd ("JS One", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains how we handle personal information when you use jsone.com.my or contact us.
legal.privacyCollectBody: When you submit a contact or newsletter form, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, company name, and message. We also receive basic technical data such as IP address and browser type from standard server logs.
legal.privacyUseBody: We use your information to respond to enquiries, provide services, improve our website, and meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal information.
legal.privacyShareBody: We may share information with trusted processors that help us operate email delivery, hosting, or security (for example captcha providers), only as needed to provide those services.
legal.privacyRetainBody: We keep enquiry records for as long as needed to handle your request and for reasonable business or legal retention periods.
legal.privacyRightsBody: You may ask us to access, correct, or delete personal information we hold about you, subject to applicable law. Contact us at info@jsone.com.my.
legal.privacyContactBody: J. S. One Sdn Bhd, B-07-08 Tower B, Bangsar South, Kuala Lumpur. Email: info@jsone.com.my. Phone: +603 2242 3986.
